design.caveats: Per-repeat errors treat the gold mean as exact: every CI and win fraction is conditional on the gold, with the gold_resolved censoring as the guard; the between-arm variance contrast is the gold-free secondary. The gold self-consistency family is 32 tests (4 QoIs x 8 obs) at 3 sigma. Raw per-repeat estimates live in logs/darcy_downstream/partial_obs*.json (kept, gitignored); the sidecar's summaries re-derive from them while they are retained.
